name: 2025 Form 1040 documents.eml
subject: Whitford 2025 Form 1040 documents
body:
Hi,

Attached are our 2025 Forms W-2, the Forms 1099 and our mortgage papers. The organizer, last year's return summary, the tax and gift spreadsheets, the estimated payment log and the HANGS letter are in the shared folder. Please prepare our 2025 Form 1040.

A few things:

- We refinanced in June. The new lender sent a 1098; the old one never did, so we used the payoff statement.
- The Children's Hospital Foundation has not sent the receipt letter for our September gift yet.
- Our IRS online account shows only three of our four estimated payments for 2025. The January one says 2026.
- Celeste's bonus was paid in January, so it is not on her 2025 W-2.

Thanks,
Celeste Whitford
